description: Google Trends related queries for one keyword: the top related searches (0-100) and the rising ones (% growth), for a country or worldwide, past 7 days to 5 years, in one $0.03 GET. Use when you need query expansion, content ideas or emerging searches around a keyword. A live call takes up to about 30 s. Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.03 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (us, gb, de, ...; uk = gb). Omit for worldwide.

keyword.description: One keyword or phrase (2-100 characters, no commas).

name: google_trends_related_queries
title: Google Trends related queries
